theme_archetype.rationale: Memories, introspection, and deep personal data mapping require a cinematic, thoughtful, and secure environment. A premium dark mode feels like an immersive 'theater' for replaying one's life, avoiding the cold clinical feel of typical data dashboards.

typography.strategy: Classic Serif Head + Sterile Mono Body

headings.usage: Use for primary titles (H1, H2) and story mode narratives. Tracking should be tight (tracking-tight) for large sizes.

body.usage: Use for metadata, timestamps, emotion tags, and data visualization labels. Enhances the 'Engine/Tech' aspect.

rules: Generous internal padding: Containers with borders must have p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.
Dashboard bento layout must use tight gap-4 or gap-6, maximizing space for data visualization.
Marketing/landing sections must use asymmetric 'Tetris' bento layouts with wide gap-8 to gap-12.
Optical Alignment over mechanical: Offset inner elements if it improves visual balance.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating navs, modal overlays.
glassmorphism.classes: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] backdrop-saturate-150

tracing_beam.classes: relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-white/30 transition-colors duration-500

texture.implementation: Apply a fixed pseudo-element with a repeating noise/film grain SVG pattern, opacity 0.05, pointer-events-none.

components_and_interactions.buttons: Flat solid background or glassmorphism. Subtle scale down on active: active:scale-95. Text color explicitly defined on hover.
components_and_interactions.inputs: Shadcn highly customized. bg-black/50 border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ethereal_gold focus:border-ethereal_gold.
components_and_interactions.modals: Use glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-3xl). Deep slate backgrounds.
components_and_interactions.hover_states: Always transition explicitly: hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300.
components_and_interactions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='memory-capture-btn').

images.description: Cinematic dark portrait of a woman looking up.
Cinematic dark portrait of a man in suit.
images.usage: Shared memory author or alternative avatar.

specific_page_instructions.dashboard_memory_map: Use react-force-graph-3d for the memory clusters. Nodes must map to emotion colors. Background must be transparent to let the app background show through. Use ethereal_gold for linking lines.
specific_page_instructions.story_mode: Maximize reading immersion. Use Cormorant Garamond heavily. Limit width to max-w-2xl. Use leading-loose. Overlay soft vignette/shadow on the edges.
specific_page_instructions.timeline_view: Vertical line in muted slate. Memory nodes should be offset asymmetrically. High contrast between date (Mono font) and narrative (Serif font).
specific_page_instructions.emotion_graphs: Use recharts. Hide axis lines for a cleaner look. Use smooth curve lines (type='monotone'). Add area gradients below the lines mapping to the emotion color.
